scope: Browsing/navigation only; preserve prior English UI edits, action mutations and entire backend.

contracts.statement: Add pure typed navigation model reading the full authoritative API snapshot (actions with project_id/tags/is_deferred, catalogs, perspectives, list_scopes); filter with no IO, mutation, order override or duplication. Verify parity against domain queryResponse/perspectiveActions using shared fixture snapshots.

No partial query response enters controller.accept. Existing full snapshot refresh/host updates remain sole source; saved filters are evaluated on its read-time projection. No query_perspective request race is introduced.
Initial destination Inbox. Fixed nav Inbox/Projects/Tags/Flagged/History; separate Perspectives list with exact saved names. No normal/Open/On hold/Later top-level button.

Projects picker includes All projects (assigned only), Unassigned and exact catalog paths; Tags picker includes All tags (tagged actions), Untagged and exact paths. Both show unfinished active/on-hold. Exact selection excludes classification descendants unless visible Include descendants is explicitly checked. Preserve action tree relative order; no membership inheritance.

Projects/Tags/Flagged default Not deferred, with visible Unfinished · Not deferred scope summary and Defer dropdown Any/Not deferred/Deferred. On hold is always included independent of this date filter. Inbox preserves existing include-deferred scope; no Defer override. History filters completed/dropped independently of Defer.

Existing saved perspective name/description/filter display verbatim. Apply exact statuses/is_deferred/flagged/project_id/tag_id/include_descendants AND predicates with no hidden unfinished or Defer intersection. Omitted statuses means all; [] means none; project null means unassigned. Description is context, never rule.

Missing selected catalog/perspective/reference yields unavailable selection and empty results with English feedback; keep ID, never silently select All. Preserve editor existence based on full snapshot, not matching list.
History contains completed and dropped; All/Completed/Dropped picker filters matches. Each row/detail keeps its lifecycle. No sorting by absent completion dates.
On hold has readable normal title, pause SVG plus On hold label; same completion/flag/edit controls. No availability or recommendation interpretation.

Navigation/filters/display/refresh retain nine editor fields, IME/caret, capture fields, review, group acknowledgment and exact unknown write. Navigation remains available while unknown; Back/Close are excluded from mutation disabling.
Quick add/capture still creates Inbox records on all views. Label and placeholder explicitly say Add to Inbox; never imply selected classification assignment.

Wide uses compact view rail, contextual classification select above the list, conditional right inspector. Narrow uses primary view selector, contextual classification picker, list and existing focused detail/Back. Perspectives have exact named options and matching rail entries.

model_surface.selectNavigation: pure selection update resets only contextual temporary filters, retains saved ID within view
model_surface.navigationPresentation: returns visible ordered actions, heading, summary, exact description, unavailable state and options
model_surface.snapshot_shape: Typed projected records; effects remain in DOM/host/controller

Actual DOM English navigation and pause label/focus accessibility
